title: Drift reports contract metadata

drift.summary: Report contracts exist, but document-level metadata and Wiki-side drift controls are becoming a distinct concept.
rationale: Project-level drift reports are implemented and useful.
Document-level metadata adds a new granularity that is not yet fully specified.
The contract should decide whether JSON metadata becomes a formal first-class artifact.

duplicates.rationale: The narrative contract and schema contract overlap; the docs should clarify which file owns semantics versus wire format.

nextAction: Promote document metadata to a contract if the prototype proves useful.
